usage: agentware prefer capture [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                                [--from-workorder AUTO/PREF-…] [--global |
                                --project PROJECT] [--key KEY] [--tags TAGS]
                                [--force]
                                [text]

positional arguments:
  text                  the preference, one line (omit with --from-workorder)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --from-workorder AUTO/PREF-…
                        activate the APPROVED tier-2 candidate of this
                        workorder: read its exact text + project scope from
                        the prefer-queue record (the loop-closing step an
                        emitted `auto/pref-…` workorder runs; refuses a
                        candidate that is not yet `prefer approve`d)
  --global              capture as a GLOBAL preference (all projects)
  --project PROJECT     scope to a KB project slug (default: auto-resolve the
                        checkout via the canonical normalizer, else global)
  --key KEY             explicit supersede key (default: derived from the
                        text); a re-capture under the same key supersedes
                        rather than stacks
  --tags TAGS           extra comma-separated tags ('preference' auto-added)
  --force               capture even if a near-duplicate exists
